### Tactical Weapon Stacking & Citations
* **Cyberarm Spurs (Retractable)**: Implanted melee weapon (*SR6 Core*, p. 285). Close combat attack pools utilize Cyberarm Agility 8 (Base 2 + 4 Cybersuite + 2 Redliner) paired with the streamed Close Combat Activesoft (Rating 6 + 1 Wireless ON).
* **Smartlinked Firearm Support**: Ranged weapons route through implanted Smartlink systems, granting +2 AR (*SR6 Core*, p. 260) and situational recoil compensation.

## 2. High-Dice Pools Over 20 (Tabletop Audit)

Under official *Shadowrun Missions* guidelines, any dice pool exceeding 20 dice is subject to rules verification for stacking legality, modifier categories, and augmented limits.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(render_multi_modifier_interactions("venn", threshold=2))
```

### Stacking Legality Summary

* **Full Matrix Defense**: Combines Willpower (7 base + 1 Bio-Response Override) + Living Persona Firewall (12) + Full Defense Action (Willpower 8). Under SR6 rules, Monad Living Personas synthesize Firewall from mental and nanite architecture (*Whisper Nets*, p. 149), allowing defensive cognitive soaking against hostile matrix spikes.
* **Damage Resistance (Soak)**: Combines Body (5) + Bone Density Augmentation R4 (+4) + Dermal Plating (+2) + Armor Rating. Bone density provides an internal structural bonus that stacks legally with cybernetic dermal plating (*Body Shop*, p. 38).

### II. Cyberlimb Redliner & 4-Limb Replacement Synergy
* **Source**: *Sixth World Companion*, p. 138 (Redliner Quality), p. 131 (Cyber Singularity Seeker), and *SR6 Core*, p. 287.
* **Full Limb Conversion**: With 4 full cyberlimbs (both arms and both legs) installed, the Redliner quality grants **+2 Agility and +2 Strength** across all physical tasks, operating safely at Essence 0.1 (*Sixth World Companion*, p. 138).
* **Cyber Singularity Seeker**: Grants **+2 Willpower** for reaching extreme low-essence augmentation thresholds (*Sixth World Companion*, p. 131).

### III. Nanite Volume & Action Surge Stacking
* **Source**: *Whisper Nets*, p. 149 & *SR6 Core*, p. 40 (Action Economy).
* **Physical Boost & Action Economy**: A Minor Action allows rolling a Nanite Volume (NV 6) test. Hits may be allocated to increase physical attributes by +1 or add +1 Minor Action per hit (*Whisper Nets*, p. 149).
* **Turn-Start 5 Minor Action Ceiling**: *"You cannot start your turn with more than 5 minor actions (all others are lost)"* (*SR6 Core*, p. 40). Pushing +4 Minor Actions from NV Boost hits this hard ceiling (**1 Major + 5 Minor Actions**).
* **In-Turn Action Trading**: After the turn begins, Venn may trade 4 Minor Actions for 1 Major Action, resulting in **2 Major Actions and 1 Minor Action** for tactical surges (*SR6 Core*, p. 40).

### IV. Skillwires & Streaming Activesoft Protocols
* **Source**: *SR6 Core*, pp. 284, 287.
* **Wireless Bonus**: Operating Skilljack R6 and Skillwires R6 with wireless connectivity enabled grants a **+1 dice pool bonus** to all streamed activesofts and permits **spending Edge** on streamed skill tests (*SR6 Core*, p. 284).
* **Streaming Ranks**: Any Rating 6 activesoft (Close Combat, Cracking, Firearms) provides **7 effective skill dice** (Rating 6 + 1 Wireless ON).

### V. SRM Monthly Expenses & Downtime Cadence Protocol
* **Source**: *Shadowrun Missions Guide v2.4*, pp. 17–19.
* **Monthly Obligations**: Every second official SRM mission, recurring expenses are settled:
  * Low Lifestyle: ¥2,000/mo (St. Simon's Island off-grid boathouse).
  * Hooder Quality (Rating 3): ¥3,000/mo allocated to coastal free clinics and solar microgrids (*Sixth World Companion*, p. 132).
* **Downtime Action Resolution**:
  * **1 Major Downtime Action**: Dedicated to *Working for the Streetdoc* (converting Karma to Nuyen for augmentations at 1 Karma : ¥7,000) or cyberware diagnostic calibration (*SRMG v2.4*, p. 18).
  * **1 Minor Downtime Action**: *Working for the People*—funded directly by the ¥3,000 Hooder obligation, generating **+1 Karma** at no additional nuyen charge (*SRMG v2.4*, p. 19).
